calculation.description: Contrarian reversal of each asset's three-day weakness relative to the cross-asset median, activated only when the five-day fraction of assets with negative returns indicates broad stress. Inputs use prices through the prior completed day and are intended for long-only ranking.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC by regime: 2020-2022 0.0162602 (63 dates), 2023-2024 0.0437040 (33 dates), 2025-2027 0.0524626 (38 dates). Stronger in later stress regimes; conditional coverage is limited, so uncertainty is material.
